description:
Seven reference-page renderers have one production consumer, the test-support `generated_artifacts` module, yet six of them compile into every adopter build.

## Background

Renderers and their gating today:

- `output::render_error_code_reference` (`crates/jit/src/output.rs:1035`).
- `domain::event_catalog::render_event_reference` (`domain/event_catalog.rs:525`, re-exported at `domain/mod.rs:61`).
- `schema::render_exit_code_reference` (`schema.rs:1134`).
- `gate_presets::reference::render_reference_markdown` (`gate_presets/reference.rs:96`, re-exported at `gate_presets.rs:20`).
- `runtime_defaults::render_reference_markdown` (`runtime_defaults.rs:56`).
- `storage::reference::render_reference_markdown` (`storage/reference.rs:456`, re-exported with `GateRunField` at `storage/mod.rs:78`).
- `profile::template_region::render_template_registry` is already gated (`profile/mod.rs:37-38`).

`generated_artifacts` is gated by `#[cfg(any(test, feature = "test-support"))]` (`lib.rs:20-21`). Each renderer's `test_support` path-constant submodule already uses that attribute (`output.rs:1016`, `schema.rs:1117`, `event_catalog.rs:34`, `gate_presets/reference.rs:11`, `runtime_defaults.rs:40`, `storage/reference.rs:42`). Renderer-only helpers would warn once gated: the `storage/reference.rs` samples, the `gate_presets/reference.rs` examples and the `event_catalog.rs` render helpers. `event_catalog()` stays live (`schema.rs:201`). Both reference modules can be gated whole.

No configured gate builds the library with `test-support` off. `scripts/cargo-ci.sh:369-492` builds with dev-dependencies, which turn the feature on. Intra-doc links from ungated docs to gated items (`runtime_defaults.rs:10`, `event_catalog.rs:7,504`, `output.rs:1027-1033`) break in a feature-off `cargo doc`. The feature comment at `crates/jit/Cargo.toml:85-95` says definitions "compile unconditionally either way", which is already inaccurate.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each reference-page renderer, its renderer-only helpers and its re-exports compile only under `cfg(any(test, feature = "test-support"))`.
- [hard] REQ-02: With `test-support` off, the workspace compiles with warnings denied. The output of `RUSTFLAGS=-Dwarnings cargo check --workspace` is recorded as evidence.
- [hard] REQ-03: No ungated rustdoc carries an intra-doc link to a gated renderer.
- [hard] REQ-04: The `test-support` feature comment in `crates/jit/Cargo.toml` describes what the feature gates.
- [hard] REQ-05: Regenerating the reference pages produces no diff.

## Notes

No new feature or CI step is added.
title: Compile reference-page renderers only with test support
